title: feat(scripts): codemod-split-protocol --members moves a member of the landed protocol.ts facade, and moves six #30054 door bodies
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DEaLDouphrUMvBWbK52b3uh)_

Refs #30518
Refs #30054

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:给 `scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs` 加了 `--members` 通道,能在已落地的 protocol.ts 门面上把单个方法体搬进它所在的 facet;并用它搬走了 #30054 的六个门(getData、cloneData 与四个 *MetaItem)。
- 为什么改:原 codemod 拒绝在自己的输出上运行,`--verify` 也因 facet 模块被手改过而无法再证明,八个门的方法体只能留在类上当例外。
- 风险与回滚:纯搬移,方法体逐字节不变,公开 `index.d.ts` / `index.d.cts` 前后字节相等;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs` 的 members 一节(生成与逆向证明);`protocol-data-crud.ts` 新增的 import 块;`scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs --members --verify --base f4d568ba`(本 PR 的基点),预期输出 `undoing the moves does rebuild … byte-for-byte`、退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**The tool.** `scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs --members A,B [--write]` moves named instance methods of the split `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` into the facet of their section, exactly as the first pass would have taken them: the same stay rules (`plan`, any reason refuses), `host-split.mjs`'s `planMove` and `insertHostEntries`, the first pass's lift and docblock-ownership rule, and the lifted one-line stub. `--members --verify --base REF` re-proves the moves on disk. The first pass is unchanged and still refuses its own output.

It accepts the hand edits `main`'s facet modules carry (header paragraphs after the generated first one, imports, top-level declarations, facet members nobody moved). It grows only: the generated first header paragraph (the name, re-wrapped), the facet class (the member in class order), and the import block (a binding joins a declaration of its specifier and kind in that declaration's own layout, or becomes a new declaration, in `protocol.ts`'s import order). It refuses a facet `protocol.ts` does not already import, a body reading a top-level name the generated export list does not export, a first paragraph that is not the generated one, and a binding the module holds under another source or kind. This is the same acceptance rule #30572 asks of the `engine.ts` `--members` pass (hand-edited headers and import blocks), kept consistent here; the engine codemod is not touched.

**The proof** is the undo against the pre-move tree, not the split's #29985 base: from the head alone, each moved body (rewrites and re-indentation undone) and any owned docblock goes back on its stub; each receiving module loses the moved members, their header names and the import bindings nothing reads any more; the factory and the interface lose the entries the base host did not carry. The result must be the base `protocol.ts` (its import bindings only moved bodies read pruned, as the first pass prunes them), `protocol-host.ts` and receiving modules byte for byte, every other section module unchanged, each facet member its base method's text as the first pass lifts it, and `host-split.mjs`'s `checkMove` green on the unlifted pair.

**The moves.** `getData`, `cloneData`, `saveMetaItem`, `publishMetaItem`, `rollbackMetaItem` and `deleteMetaItem` now delegate to `ProtocolDataCrudFacet`, `ProtocolSaveFacet`, `ProtocolHistoryAndPublishFacet`, `ProtocolPackageCommitsFacet` and `ProtocolDiffDeleteLoadFacet`; `protocol-host.ts` gains the eight entries those bodies read. Their six rows leave `scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json` (50 named exceptions remain). Written by `node scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs --members getData,cloneData,saveMetaItem,publishMetaItem,rollbackMetaItem,deleteMetaItem --write`, no hand edit after it.

`getDiscovery` and `findData` stay for the second PR of #30518: all eight together come to 3,775 changed lines, over the 3,000-line budget. Their two rows now name #30518.

## Why

#30054 spelled the eight doors' return types (PR #30516) so their bodies could leave the facade, but the codemod could not move a member of a facade that had already landed. #30518 asked for that pass.

## Tests

- `node scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs --self-test`: 85 cases in 10 batteries pass. Three new batteries: `members pass` (8: the move proves; stub; class-order placement before the next member and last; header paragraph with a hand-written paragraph kept; import joins its declaration; new declaration ahead of `ProtocolHost`'s with a hand-written import kept; `protocol.ts` prune; determinism), `members proof` (12 negative controls, each must change the head and must fail: an edited moved body, an edited hand-written facet member, a second blank line, a header missing a name, a changed untouched module, an edited interface entry, an entry no `Pick` names, a stub calling another facet, an edited public docblock, an edit elsewhere in `protocol.ts`, a dropped import no moved body reads, a proof over nothing) and `members refusals` (10).
- The pass on `main` (`f4d568ba`): `--members` (six names) exits 0 and `--members --verify --base HEAD~1` at head exits 0: 6 moved, `checkMove` 6/6, `protocol.ts` 13,927 -> 13,743 lines, 9 import bindings pruned. Measured also with all eight names: exit 0, `checkMove` 8/8, the built declarations byte-equal too.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` at `c2e3fa7f`: vitest 317 files passed / 4 skipped, 22,454 tests passed / 26 skipped (exit 0); `typecheck` exit 0.
- Facade gate negative control: the head registry over `main`'s `src/`: exit 1, six problems, one per moved door; at head exit 0 (50 named exceptions).

## Acceptance notes

- Premises re-measured on `main` `f4d568ba`: the first pass still refuses its own output (exit 2), and `--verify --base 48914fdc^` is now 77/85 bodies and 69/78 `checkMove` (the card read 79/85, 71/78; more hand edits since).
- The second PR (same card thread, `Fixes #30518`) moves `getDiscovery` and `findData` with this pass. `findData` has a path reader, `protocol.query-transport-dialect.test.ts` (`the fold names the spec export at the call site` reads `protocol.ts`), which goes red when only the body moves (measured); that PR gives the reader the facet module, as ruling 6597555122 item 3 does. `scripts/check-filter-alias-parity.mjs` also reads `protocol.ts` and is re-run there.
- `PATH_READER_NEEDLES` is empty in this codemod, so the first pass would not have kept `findData` for that reader either; not changed here (it is the first pass's table).
- A lifted public member's return type keeps the method's own line breaks re-indented one level, as the first pass's lift writes it (the undo depends on it).
- The `--self-test` of this codemod is not run by a CI workflow (true on `main` too); run locally above.

</details>

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
